verdict.rationale: Langfuse's docs say prompts are managed centrally rather than hardcoded. Non-technical users update them in the UI, the application automatically fetches the latest version, and version control plus labels manage deployments across environments. A hands-on user also reports prompt versioning has been 'immensely valuable'. missing for 10: explicitly documented rollback workflow, protected production labels without an enterprise license (they require a license key), and independent evidence on advanced versioning features (one user found them behind PromptLayer).

support.subject: As a developer, I can version prompts and deploy changes to production without shipping code

citations.quote: Instead of hardcoding prompts in your application code, you manage them centrally in Langfuse.
non-technical team members update them directly in the UI while your application automatically fetches the latest version.
Use version control and labels to manage deployments across environments
The prompt versioning has been immensely valuable!
